en: A black and white image of a rural, hilly landscape with a large house or manor nestled among bare trees. A winding road curves around the building. In the background, wooded hills rise gently with a scattering of trees on top. The architecture of the building has large arched windows and a gabled roof, appearing European and likely from the 19th or early 20th century. There is no visible text on the image.
